# Heraldic Clouds Inc.

> Heraldic Clouds Inc. pursues a mission to develop AGI, advance MEA Cloud Desktops, and build PeopleWelcome, a social media platform for humans and machines. These are goals, not claims of achieved AGI or current product availability.

The current site is a company overview and archive-inspired presentation. MEA feature statements below describe the historical concept and should not be interpreted as confirmation of a currently available product or service. The site has no affiliate storefront or third-party tracking.

## Pages

- [Heraldic home](https://www.heraldic.cloud/): Company overview, mission, privacy approach, and navigation.
- [Media](https://www.heraldic.cloud/media/): Original GTC 2017 MEA and Cloud Primary Personal Computers posters, with PDF downloads.
- [Mise En Abyme (MEA)](https://www.heraldic.cloud/mea/): Historical MEA concept, original feature statements, and archived imagery.
- [MEA plain-text reference](https://www.heraldic.cloud/mea.md): Markdown version of the historical concept.

## Company and project context

- MEA stands for Mise En Abyme, a historical virtual cloud desktop concept.
- The archived concept described blending software, hardware, and the web; streaming games from the cloud; turning a smartphone into a desktop computer; next-generation security; a Cloud+-certified team; and IPv6 Internet addresses.
- These points are preserved as historical presentation copy, not current availability, product, or security guarantees.
- The Heraldic site presents the company's mission around access to technology and knowledge.
